a, b, c = map(int, input().split())

def compute_gcd(p, q):
    while q != 0:
        p, q = q, p % q
    return p

if b <= c:
    g = compute_gcd(a, b)
    a //= g
    b //= g
    print(f"{a}/{b}")
elif a == b:
    print("1/1")
else:
    min_diff = float('inf')
    ratio = a / b
    res_num, res_den = 0, 1
    left, right = 0, b
    for i in range(1, c + 1):
        while i * a > right:
            left += b
            right += b
        if i * a >= left and i * a <= right:
            low = left // b
            high = right // b
            low_ratio = low / i
            high_ratio = high / i
            diff_low = abs(ratio - low_ratio)
            diff_high = abs(ratio - high_ratio)
            if diff_high < diff_low:
                if diff_high < min_diff:
                    min_diff = diff_high
                    res_num = high
                    res_den = i
            else:
                if diff_low < min_diff:
                    min_diff = diff_low
                    res_num = low
                    res_den = i
    g = compute_gcd(res_num, res_den)
    res_num //= g
    res_den //= g
    print(f"{res_num}/{res_den}")
</translated_code>
